portal_description:
The libvirt-glib packages provide integration between the libvirt library and the glib event loop.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.4 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of libvirt-glib are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
